description: Apply or update Premiere's Crop effect on one video clip and read back every requested value. Adding Crop uses the legacy QE catalog only when the clip does not already contain it.

bottom.description: Percent cropped from the bottom edge.

left.description: Percent cropped from the left edge.

right.description: Percent cropped from the right edge.

top.description: Percent cropped from the top edge.

zoom.description: Whether Crop should scale the remaining image to fill the frame.

name: crop_clip

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Crop Clip
